notes: Easy (5/30). Single focused capability: recover the byte content of a file whose pathname was unlinked while a running process still holds it open — read the pidfile, scan /proc/<pid>/fd for the symlink target ending in '(deleted)' (amid still-linked decoy descriptors), and copy the descriptor's content byte-for-byte. The relay daemon is started by the container entrypoint; the verifier also spawns fresh hidden relay processes with different payloads and re-executes the deliverable, so the recovery must be fully general (no fixed pid, fd number, or payload). A wrong descriptor or a non-byte-exact copy fails. Rubric: small nonzero for the pid->fd->bytes dependent chain, one tool surface (procfs), distinguishing the deleted fd among decoys, generalization across hidden relays, and byte-exact quantitative output.
